about: I have been very passionate about software development since I first began programming. I always try to do my best to solve problems and I work at my best when helping other people. This passion led me to often challenge myself and learn new skills that helped me to create better solutions. For example, I used to program on a chromebook which had less than great performance, so I taught myself many techniques for how to optimize speed and ram usage because of how often my projects crashed, that was the beginning of my obsession with optimization. Since I began contributing to open source I have learned much about improving performance without sacrificing readability or maintainability.
